items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Frankie Jackson, I knew him before I left for Newark.

ctx.x: Now, before we leave Atlantic City, I wanted to ask you about some of the other performers who were around when you got back there. Was like, Frankie, 'half-pint', Jackson, was --

Well, Frankie, half-pint, Jackson, Frankie Jackson, I knew him before I left for Newark. Now, he worked up there and there was something I wanted to tell you about him. He said something that was almost a sacrilege. You know how you --he used to talk on the floor between his songs. They all took that from Madison Reed. Madison was the first man used to make up stories on his songs. So he was singing a song, and this was near around Easter time, so he was tellin' the -- preaching. Like a lot of the comedians do in…
